The reference hands

Eight verified states (no flush and no straight possible), true six-way equity from 20,000-draw Monte Carlo. The acting seat is the same in every row; the opponents are the scripted folders and a caller.

Dead trunk · 600-scale reward

Every unit in both hidden layers is dead, so these are constant policies: the action never changes with the hand.
